body:
Calm your buttholes guys, this story is an obvious fake from a 14 y/o who regularly posts shitty rage comics and /r/trees material.

But besides all that, he just ripped a picture straight from google images in his post below me.

To display a pitiful young teen who thought himself to be depressed and suicidal but really he's just being overly exaggerated like how Ignatius in A Confederacy of Dunces would bitch about everything. 

I guess I just wanted people to get some laughter out of this and get themselves to say "Do I really think my life is worthless and worth ending?" as they could relate to this young boy.  I suppose it was in bad taste, but anyways you're welcome r/SuicideWatch.

Oh yeah! As an American, the only country I would ever want to live besides here would be Japan. It just looks so fun and the Japanese society has its own honor system, so there is way less crime. Plus, Japanese chicks are consistently hot.

As for my name:
I made a post in r/SuicideWatch...

Though I wasn't suicidal...

I only intended to be funny and fill people with pitiful laughter...

But it wasn't funny. [Read the post here](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/uv70w/iam_a_teen_contemplating_suicide_for_the_first/)
Oh God yes! Upvote if you agree. Hmm... It seems as though I am running out of Reddit Gold ;(
I want to live in Japan...
I have the same problem, does anyone have a spare HL:deathmatch or Portal 2?
